name: CalendarView
intent: Month calendar that lays out events (with tones) across days — for viewing schedules, not picking dates.
when: Display events or a schedule in a month grid
Show an interactive calendar of activities

chooseOver.because: Calendar is a date picker for selecting dates into inputs; CalendarView displays events on a month grid

commonMistakes.mistake: Using CalendarView CalendarView to pick a date for a form field
commonMistakes.avoidOverride: Use CalendarView to pick a date for a form field — use Calendar / DatePicker instead

usage: Use CalendarView to enhance your user interface. This component provides a consistent, accessible, and well-designed solution for this use case.
CalendarView integrates seamlessly with other components in the design system. Follow the established patterns and guidelines to ensure consistency across your application.

props.name: month
props.description: Controls which month is visible. Pair with onMonthChange.

props.name: defaultMonth
props.description: Initial month for uncontrolled use. Defaults to today's month.

props.name: today
props.description: Day to highlight as "today". Defaults to new Date().

props.name: weekStartsOn
props.description: Day-of-week the grid starts on. Defaults to Monday (1).

props.name: addItemLabel
props.description: Label for the add-item affordance. Defaults to "Add work item".

props.name: headerActions
props.description: Slot rendered on the right side of the header (next to "Today"). Use for an Options dropdown, view-mode switcher, etc.
